info.title: Package Registry Service API
info.description: Owns package metadata, package membership, package-specific Tamagotchi statistic definitions, and Monster Raid configurations and schedules. Package moderators manage their own package configuration, while globally privileged admins manage raid configuration and scheduling.

get.description: Callable by clients and internal services. Returns a cursor-based page of packages.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous page

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of packages per page

get.description: Callable by clients and internal services.

patch.description: Callable by package moderators and admins.

post.description: Callable by package developers and admins.

delete.description: Callable by package developers and admins.

post.summary: Register a user with a package
post.description: Callable only by User Management Service. Idempotent for a given Idempotency-Key.

get.description: Callable by User Management Service and Guild Service.
Callable only by User Management Service.

get.description: Callable by clients, admins, and Monster Raid Service. Returns a cursor-based page of raid configurations.

parameters.name: cursor

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of configurations per page
